mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5.0 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals economic expansion and higher corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of four consecutive monthly rises in INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 for three consecutive months signals labor market strength and higher consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 130,000 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,500 for three consecutive months signals weakening residential investment and lower construction-related earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 1,500 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which prompts tighter monetary policy and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL > 103.0 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
